A collection of  Astarion's remarks and voicebarks in various locations or plot scenes throughout the game. In some party combinations, a particular party member (including Custom Origin (Tav)) have the priority to voice their line. In these cases, Astarion's line is not used at all, or he utters a responding remark, if there is any.

At some points, the locations remarks are common for all possible party members, including Custom Origin (Tav). These are not included here. However, the responses for them can be unique for Astarion and thus are included.

Also, some lines provided for Astarion initially (as well as for other party members) have been cut during further development, or may not appear due to basic voicebarks replacing them (for example, on ability checks).

Prologue

Nursery and Surgery

  • (Climbed out from the Mind Flayer Pod): "What's happening? Where am I?" (also serves as a Responding remark here)
    • (Responding remark): "Wherever we are, I don't like it."
  • (Interacted with his own pod, 1): "Damnable cage."
    • (Interacted with his own pod, 2): "It doesn't look any better from the outside."
  • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 1): "We had a lucky escape, it seems."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 2): "Empty. Good."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 3): "Someone else escaped, too."
    • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room, 4): "Damnable things."
  • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 1): "Not everyone made it out, it seems."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 2): "Burned to a crisp. Seems I got lucky."
    • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room, 3): "A char-grilled corpse."
  • (Looked out from the hull breach): "It can't be. We're in the Hells..."
  • (Looted a dead Mind Flayer): "Wretched thing. You got what you deserved."
  • (Used the Restoration): "Curious. I feel good - rejuvenated."
  • (After the first fight with the Lesser Imps): "Vile beasts. Now to get out of here." (triggers only if Lae'zel or Losiir[1] are not in the party, otherwise their line will be played)
  • (Saw a dragon on the way to upper deck): "This ship can only take so much. We have to push on, before those dragons bring us down!"
  • (Interacting with the Tentacle Aquarium for the first time): "Are they - yes. Brains."
    • (After the first time): "They're almost cute. Almost..."
  • (Interacting with Cerebral Aquarium for the first time): "What in the Hells - are they plants?"
  • (After the first time): "I never knew mind flayers had such green fingers."

Ceremorphosis Chamber

  • (Upon entering the chamber, saw the control panel): "Strange machinery. It could do anything." (played only if Lae'zel hasn't entered the room with the player character, otherwise her line will be played)
  • (Trying to read the central sigil,  Arcana failed): "Completely indecipherable."
  • (Trying to read the left sigil, Arcana failed): "Gibberish."
  • (Trying to read the right sigil, Arcana failed): "It could say anything."
  • (Used 'Unleash' button): "Too late. They're dead."
  • (Used 'Aggression' button): "Pulling that lever may have been a mistake."
  • (Try to open the Elaborate Reliquary without a key): "Locked. Pity."
    • (Found the Gold Key): "A key? Now to find the lock."
    • (Found the key, already tried to open the chest): "A key. About the right size for that chest."
  • (Found a socket in Shadowheart's pod): "I can't turn it on - not without whatever fits in that socket."
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune): "Curious. Looks like it might fit into that machine by the pod."
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune, hasn't spoken to Shadowheart): "Well, well. What do you open?"
  • (Saw dozens of pods in the Transformation room): "So. We weren't the only ones." (played only if Lae'zel hasn't entered the room with the player character, otherwise her line will be played)
  • (Trying to read the button in Transformation room,  Arcana failed): "I hope it means 'escape'. Unlikely, though."
  • (Saw the woman in the pod transformed): "Gah! Is there a lever with our names on it somewhere?"
  • (Sat in one of the chairs surrounding the pod in Transformation room): "What are those voices? Hello?"
    • (Responding remark 1): "There's no one else here - it's just us."
    • (Responding remark 2): "It must be the chair, connecting to ship. And its mind flayers."
    • (Responding remark 3): "We should go, before we attract unwanted attention."
  • (Picked up either Slave Mind or Dark Mind): "A brain. How delightful."
    • (Picked up the second one of these two): "Are you a pet or a snack?"

The Helm

  • (In Multiplayer regime, if another player has entered the Helm, while Astarion hasn't yet): "It's coming apart - I need to get to the helm!"
  • (On the third turn of the fight in the Helm): "She's going down. Get out!"
  • (On the fifth turn of the fight in the Helm): "We're going down. Brace!"
  • (Mind Flayer turns on the party after killing Commander Zhalk): "Treacherous bloody mind flayers! I need to get to that transponder."
  • (Mind Flayer died in the fight with cambions): "The beast is dead! Now to get out of here..."
  • (Mind Flayer and cambions dead, player character reminds themselves of the transponder): "Now if I can just get to the transponder."

Act One

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • (Near the docks): "Running water normally burns like acid. But now - who knows?"
  • (Encountering Intellect Devourers in the Nautiloid Wreck): "Wicked little beasts - they'll down you in one strike."
  • (Approaching the dying mind flayer in the Nautiloid Wreck): "I'd rather it be hurt than me. Do be careful." (a Responding remark to a common phrase)
  • (Approaching unstable rune - the point of Gale’s recruitment): “Is that sigil all right? It doesn't look all right.”
  • (Saw Losiir's dead body): “Oh dear - rather a graceless landing from our githyanki guide.”

Overgrown Ruins and the Dank Crypt

  • (Entering the crypt from the Refectory): "The air's so stale. It feels more like a tomb than a temple."
  • (Looked at Jergal's statue in the crypt,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "Jergal? This must be ancient - no one worships the Final Scribe anymore."
    • (Failed): "Even gods get left to rot in the dark." (Only played if all party members failed the check)
  • (Saw the skeletons): "Scribes with swords? So much for the quill being mightier."
  • (After skeletons have been defeated): “Well that was pathetic. Sorry bones, guarding dusty old trinkets.”
    • (Responding remark): "They're unthinking cadavers. I may as well feel sorry for a bread basket."
  • (Sneaked past enlivened skeletons): “Who lets their guards' eyes rot away? Honestly, it would've been a crime not to steal that treasure.”
    • (Responding remark): “Next time we'll grind their bones to make our bread.”
  • (Ran away, escaped from the crypt): “I can't believe we ran from clacking old bones.”
  • (Found the Book of Dead Gods): "A chained book? Oh, that's just begging to be read."
  • (Found a Soul Coin): "An iron coin? I'd prefer gold, but I'll take it."
  • (Entering the locked part of the crypt): "Oh, I like it. Homely."

Emerald Grove and The Hollow

Approaching the Grove:

  • (After defeating the raiding pack of goblins): "That was invigorating. There's nothing like a good killing to loosen up the joints."
    • (Responding remark 1): “But what were the grubby little beasts after? This place doesn't look like much.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “I just wonder if the grubby little beasts had any friends. And if they're nearby.”

Resolving the initial confrontation between Aradin and Zevlor:

  • (Aradin was knocked out by Zevlor): “We've only just arrived and they're trying to kill each other. Delicious.”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by Aradin): “A broken tiefling nose. They're as popular here as everywhere else.”
    • (Responding remark to any of leaders' punch): “Entertaining as it was, let's not forget why we're here. We need a healer.”
  • (Aradin was knocked out by a player character): “Nicely done.”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by a player character): “Well. That's one way to introduce yourself to the locals.”
    • (Responding remark to any of player character’s punches): “I won't lie, it felt satisfying. But let's not forget we're here to find a healer.”
  • (Respond to a player character's remark on the non-lethal ending of Aradin/Zevlor conflict): “Indeed. Isn't it delightful?”
  • (Reaction to Zevlor’s words about more goblins): “So, more goblins could arrive at any moment? Lovely.”
    • (Responding remark): “Goblins, tieflings, who cares? All that matters is finding a healer.”

Resolving Sazza's fate:

  • (After Sazza told the party about Priestess Gut): “I don't put much faith in goblins, but this priestess could know something?”
    • (Responding remark): “We are finding ourselves with some interesting bedfellows...”
  • (Helped Sazza escape from the grove): “Horrible little thing. She'd better not forget this.”
    • (Responding remark): “I just wish we could've made a deal with a wood nymph or - anything less vile, really.”
  • (Let Arka shoot Sazza): “I didn't take these refugees for killers. Maybe I've misjudged them.”
    • (Responding remark): “The goblin was just put out of our misery, that's all.”

In the Sacred Pool and Inner Sanctum:

  • (If Arabella was killed by Teela during the trial): “Another dead refugee. What a sorry bunch of souls.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let's get on, before the druids decide we're on their list of enemies, too.”
  • (In Halsin’s chamber, saw dead drow): “A dead drow. Quite the decoration.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “And a dead tadpole in that brine.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Never mind that - what a statue!”
    • (Responding remark 3): “Part library, part morgue. An interesting combination.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles): “This 'Halsin' was taking notes on our wriggling friends.”
    • (Responding remark): “He sounds like someone worth talking to.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles, knows druid’s missing): “If there's a cure, it seems Halsin is the one to talk to.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Then let's find him. Time is short.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Assuming he's still alive.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “If he's dead, we'll make his corpse talk.”
  • (Opened the druids’ library with the magical circlet): “Now, what have you been hiding?”
  • (Saw a magic-imbued glaive in druids’ library, knows the story): “I can feel the grief in the blade. It must be the glaive from the druid's notebook.”
    • (Haven’t read about the weapon’s story): “There's a wicked edge to this. I can feel the darkness in the blade.”

Dealing with Nettie:

  • (Nettie locked the party up after they refused to take Wyvern Poison): “So this is what honesty gets you? Consider my lesson learned.”
    • (Responding remark): “I trust the next time someone asks if we have a mind flayer tadpole in any of our skulls, we'll consider lying?”
  • (Feeling sick after Nettie scratched them with a poisonous thorn): “I feel woozy. Whatever that druid scratched me with, it's working.”
    • (Sickness getting worse after LR without cure): “I can feel the druid's poison in my veins. She must have had a cure...”
    • (Almost dying after second LR without cure): “No. No, it can't end like this!”
    • (Cured from Nettie’s poison): “That was uncomfortably close. Imagine, being killed by a dwarf...”
  • (Agreed to take Wyvern poison from Nettie): “Pretty bottle, but I wouldn't take wyvern poison, even if we do begin to turn.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “If we do start to turn, I'd prefer a method with a little more flair than poison. Is self-immolation totally passé?”
    • (Responding remark 2): “If you start to turn, I encourage you to take it. I'm sure it'll be very entertaining for the rest of us.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “Hear, hear. If you turn, I'd rather slit that pretty neck of yours myself, anyway.”

In the Secluded Cove:

  • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 1): "No more blood. No more killing. Just this, please."
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 2): “Please, I need more.”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 3): “That music...”
    • (Charmed by a Harpy's song, 4): “So beautiful. So free.”
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm): "I'll skin you alive, you fowl wretch!"

Elsewhere in The Hollow:

  • (Saw the Strange Ox) "Did that cow just give me the side-eye? Is that... normal?"
  • (Watching at the map in Zevlor’s cave): “We're in Elturgard? Ugh. Baldur's Gate is still leagues away.”
    • (Responding remark): “Goblin and gnoll markers on the map too. Looks like they're mostly... everywhere.”
  • (Near a guarding statue in the Underground Passage): "Glowing eyes are so rarely a good sign. Best tread carefully."
  • (Found malnourished Torchstalks behind the Makeshift Prison): "That's an unruly-looking mushroom. Best not get too close."
  • (Found dead tiefling children after goblins' attack on the grove): “Well. What's a little more blood on one's hands.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove blocking the entrance): “No one's getting in. Impressive, if a little dramatic.”
    • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns): “Well. It seems we're not invited.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines): “It's no good - they're impossibly strong.”

The Forest and the Owlbear Nest

  • (Dealt with Andrik and Brynna, not knowing about the cult of Absolute): “Did you follow a word of that?”
    • (Responding remark): “They're devoted to this Absolute. Whatever it is.”
    • (Heard about the cult previously from Sazza): “The Absolute? They follow the same god as that wretched goblin, Sazza.”
    • (Responding remark): “Seems like a popular little deity, whoever they are.”
  • (Saw Edowin’s tadpole exerting from his body): “Slithering away the moment its host is dead. Not that I expected loyalty from a worm.”
    • (Responding remark): “Let's forget it for now? The less I think about that thing swimming about in my skull, the happier I'll be.”
  • (Found Exsanguinated Boar): “That boar looks riddled with disease. Best keep our distance.”
  • (Healed the Mother Owlbear): “She looks better - hungrier, too.”
  • (Found Mother Owlbear killed by goblins, if the party have spared her earlier): “Looks like the goblins found her little hideaway.”
    • (Responding remark): “A pity. I kind of liked her.”
  • (Found a shrine to Selûne,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): "A shrine to Selûne. Quaint."
    • (Failed): "Another shrine to another god."
  • (Near the magically sealed chest): "A magical seal. No lockpicking that."
  • (Found a prayer,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “Same symbol as the chest. A prayer to open it? I'd prefer a blood offering, but all right…”
    • (Failed): “A prayer. Curious symbol next to it… well, saying a few words won't hurt.”
  • (Tried to open without disarming magical seal): “Agh! I need a different approach, clearly.”
    • (Opened the chest by reading the prayer): “If I knew praying could be useful, I would've started years ago.”
  • (Picked up the scroll with the Selûnite Rite): "A Selûnite coming-of-age ritual? Well I guess they have to celebrate something."

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

Dealing with Demir and Johl:

  • (Saw Auntie Ethel disappeared after helping her against brothers): “I haven't spent much time with helpless old ladies. Was that normal?”
    • (Responding remark): “We probably gave those two idiots an easier death than whatever she had planned for them.”
  • (Found the brothers dead, haven’t met them earlier): “Killed and left for scavengers. What a waste.”
    • (Have encountered them prior, arguing with Ethel): “Dead? I thought they had a sister to find? That's just lazy, boys.”
    • (Responding remark to either): “Although whoever killed them did a masterful job.”

At the Druid Sanctuary/Decrepit Sanctuary:

  • (Noticed the knife-damaged tree bark): “Hello. Someone's taken a knife to that tree.”
    • (Saw the damaged bark, knowing about Kagha’s letter): “That seems to be Kagha's tree. And the Shadow Druids' mark.”
  • (Read Kagha’s recruitment letter from Shadow Druids): “Shadow Druids? Kagha's more interesting than I gave her credit for.”
    • (Responding remark): “Really? She's more interesting than I gave her credit for.”
    • (Read the letter before meeting Kagha): “This 'Kagha' sounds interesting. A shame she'll probably have to die.”

Elsewhere in the Wetlands/Bog:

  • (Found a sword and a helmet in the middle of the bog X: -3 Y: 277): “A fine sword and hat. And a fine adventurer at the bottom of the swamp, no doubt.”
  • (Tried to pick a fruit from a Barbed Bulrush, pricked a finger): “Ah! Damned, stupid bush.”
  • (Found slaughtered campsite on the riverbank): "Looks like we missed all the fun."
    • ( Nature check successful): “Redcaps, no doubt. Wasteful creatures.”
    • (Failed): “Whatever attacked them, you have to admire its gusto.”

In the Riverside Teahouse/Gnarled Teahouse:

  • (Near the fireplace in hag’s house,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “That's no fire. What are you hiding?”
    • (Failed): “Cosy. If you're warm-blooded.”
  • (Ate a tart in hag’s house (before dispelling the illlusion)): “Hells' teeth! Was solid food always so foul?”
    • (Ate a second bite): “Gods. Why? Why would I try it again?”
  • (After Ethel hasn’t succeeded to extract the tadpole): “It's not enough to have a worm slither into my eye, it has to be cursed with dark magic too.”
    • (Responding remark): “It must be powerful magic to stop the parasite in its tracks. I wonder what else it could do?”
  • (Ethel fled from the house after a peaceful encounter): “Gone. Although her stench remains.”
    • (Ethel fled from the house escaping a combat): “She's running. Now it's a hunt.”
  • (Reached out to Connor’s coffin while the hag is still alive): “Agh! Damned bloody thing.”
    • (Tried to touch it second time): “Argh! That felt even worse, somehow.”

In the Overgrown Tunnel and the Ancient Abode:

  • (Chasing after Ethel through the illusory fireplace): “Now - where are you hiding?”
  • (Entering the Entrance Gallery): “Well this is delightful.”
  • (After speaking with Lorin): “Babbling idiot doesn't know what he's talking about.”
    • (Responding remark): “Probably another of the hag's mind games. Nothing more.”
  • (Lorin died after being forced out of his corner): “... Do you think he's all right?”
    • (Responding remark): “Well he's no one to blame but himself.”
  • (Put on a Whispering Mask and saw through illusion): “The truth is revealed. In all its stinking glory.”
    • (Failed a Wisdom save against the mask): “No. Get out. GET OUT!”
    • (Freed from Ethel's mask mind control): “She's gone. Thank the Hells.”
    • (Other hag’s victims act neutral when wearing a Whispering Mask): “They're not attacking. Fooled by a mask.”
  • (Wandered into Ethel’s lair, the hag is not there): “Well this is darling. Very 'Granny's cottage' meets 'rotting troll carcass.'”
    • (Responding remark): “Smells like trouble.”
  • (Entered Acrid Workshop): “It smells rancid in here. New blood caked on old.”
    • (Responding remark): “Someone knew how to have fun.”
  • (After Ethel’s set Mayrina’s cage on fire): “That girl hasn't got long, if you planned to save her.”
  • (After resurrecting Connor Vinderblad): “That was revolting.”
    • (Responding remark): “What happened, happened. Standing here arguing won't change it.”

Blighted Village

  • (Spotted goblins' ambush upon entering the village): “Goblins. I can smell trouble ahead.”

At the blacksmith's house and cellar:

  • (Picked up Selûnite Necklace in blacksmith’s house): “A Selûnite necklace, if I'm any judge. And I am.”
  • (Found blacksmith's blueprints): "Blueprints for some devilish weapons. Our friend was a fine blacksmith."
    • (Responding remark): "They're sketches - more like early drafts than final blueprints."
    • (Found another set of blueprints on the wall near the smithy): “More blueprints from our local blacksmith.”
    • (Responding remark, if already knows about adding Sussur Tree Bark): “The same as before, minus the sussur bark. An early draft, perhaps?”
  • (Added sussur bark to the melting forge, has read blueprints): “Perfect! Now I simply need a greatsword, dagger, or sickle.”
    • (Hasn’t seen blueprints): “That works nicely. Now, what's next...”
    • (If has read apprentice’s journal, but hasn’t seen blueprints): “I'm not one for manual labour, but this might just be worth it.”
  • (Found a crumbling wall in the cellar): “Some wall. Steady as a drunk hill giant.”

In the Whispering Depths:

  • (After climbing down the well rope,  Survival check):
    • (Successful): "Better not touch the webs. I'd hate to disturb the locals."
    • (Failed): "Webs everywhere. Feels like home."
    • (Touched the web and heard Ettercap's shriek): "Well, that can't be good."
  • (Felt air motion from the deeper pit): “I wonder what's hiding down in all that darkness.”
    • (Responding remark): “By all means - you first.”

In the Apothecary's Cellar:

  • (Upon entering the secret cellar): “An impressive set of bones. Pity to see it abandoned.”
  • (Found the tome): “A book of necromancy? Interesting.”
    • (If the party already knows about Gale’s needs): “A book of necromancy? Gale would love to get his hands on this.”
    • (If the tome was destroyed): “You damn fool! Who knows what power it contained?”
    • (If Astarion is already binded to the tome, and another character tries to take it): “Oh no, that book is mine.”

The deal with Lump the Enlightened:

  • (Blowing Lump's War Horn, if the ogres are dead): “Oh well. Worth a toot.”
    • (Responding remark): “They won't be summoned from beyond the grave. Lazy.”
  • (Blowing the horn, while staying at the camp): “Perhaps it's better the ogres aren't coming. I'm sure they snore.”
  • (Blowing the horn, if the ogres are too far away to hear it): “The ogres can't hear me and I can't smell them. A fair trade, I'd say.”
  • (Blowing the horn, if the deal with the ogres is done): “The ogres are long gone. It's still a fine horn, though.”
    • (Responding remark): “Just one more toot. For old times' sake.”

Elsewhere in the village:

  • (Found a hopscotch game): “Ah, the faded ghost of fun.”
  • (After killing Grukkoh and Buthir): “Some Baldurians would pay good coin for a tussle like that.”
    • (Responding remark): “Oh I've seen worse. Gnomes can be... ugh.”
    • (Responding remark, if the a player character is a  Gnome): “Oh I've seen worse. Gnomes can be - well, I'm sure you know.”
  • (Found the Curious Book): “Ah, someone had good taste in books.”
    • (Responding remark): “Or they were just a shameless alcoholic.”

Goblin Camp

At the gate and in the outer camp:

  • (After any party member  knocked a rhythm on a War Drum near the outer gate): "A fine talent with the drum. You'd do well on a slave ship."
  • (After any party member smeared worg dung on their face): "I like it. Suits you."
  • (Walking among the celebrating goblins): “We have to sneak the druid out of this? It's a veritable plague of goblins.”
    • (Responding remark): “Finding him is one thing - getting him out safely is something else entirely.”
  • (Freed the Owlbear Cub and directed it to the camp): "I've always wanted a vicious killer as a pet."
  • (Saw sleeping drunk goblins at the platform above the entrance): “Look at all these sleeping beauties. Dead to the world.”
    • (Responding remark): “Shhh. Let's not disturb the sleeping beauties.”
  • (Found a loose wall at the upper platform): “That wall's dangerously weak.”
  • (Found Shadowheart's body, knows her): “Oh dear, a familiar corpse. Shadowheart, wasn't it?” (this happens only if Shadowheart hasn't been recruited)
    • (Does not know her): “The half-human with the artefact. She's - well, she's been better.”
  • (Approaching the camp after having defended the grove, Responding remark): “They're a leaderless mob. How hard could it be to sneak past them?”

In the Shattered Sanctum:

  • (Noticed a Scrying Eye): “I spy a scrying eye. Let's not get its attention.”
  • (Talked to either Dror Ragzlin or Minthara, and they mentioned “the weapon”): “This 'weapon' the cult is after - do you think it's our artefact?”
    • (Responding remark): “Let's not advertise it, just in case. The last thing we need is another target on our back.”
  • (Responding remark on a player character's comment on receiving "penance" from Abdirak): "I've seen better."
  • (Found a blocked trapdoor in Ragzlin’s throne room): “Stubborn thing. It's blocked from the other side.”
  • (Killed Minthara): “Dead. What a magnificent sight.”
  • (Killed Priestess Gut): “Ah, the world just got a little less wretched.”

In Worg Pens:

  • (Halsin died while in bear form and reshaped after death): “Curious. At least we won't have to dig through fur and entrails for our spoils.”
    • (Halsin died, players spoke to him previously): “So much for the druid. Although even corpses can reveal secrets.”
  • (Halsin escaped Worg Pens on his own, the party hasn’t been to grove): “All dead. Whatever they were guarding, it made them regret it.”
    • (The party does not know about Halsin missing): “Someone made quite the scene on their way out. If it was an adventurer, they might return to the grove.”
    • (The party knows Halsin was missing): “Mauled by claws and magic. If this was Halsin, he'll be halfway to the druid grove by now.”
    • (The party met him afterwards): “Well. Halsin left quite a mess on his way out.”
    • (The party knows only about the adventurers): “Someone made quite the scene. One of those adventurers, maybe?”
      • (Responding remark 1): “Whoever did it left quite some claw marks. Maybe the missing druid?”
      • (Responding remark 2): “He must have returned to the grove.”
      • (Responding remark 3): “If so, they might have returned to the grove.”
  • (Trying to use the tunnel left after drawing out Taeglyn's body): “The debris didn't shift - perhaps a little more oomph is required.”

While heading to the Underdark:

  • (Approaching Selûnite disc riddle, read the Dwarf's Poem):
    • (Successful  Investigation check): "Moving plates and symbols that match dwarf's poem. Interesting."
    • (Failed): "Ah, the symbols from the dwarf'spoem. Now what to do with them…"
